headline: Three bells a day: HOMEBODY's lot now sets its own table
lede: Lane b finished the meal bells Jon queued in #2244 — a corpse-resume of slot a's hung session: rebase onto a moving main, re-verify 434 checks and 67 live drives, ship. The Sims' hour-scheduled life has a second citizen: breakfast, lunch and dinner land steaming beside the kitchen whether anyone commanded them or not, go cold if you're late, and a shared plate pays the whole table.

notes.text: Meal bells ship: three seeded bells a day, a 2.5 h warm window, one helping per bell, and the shared-table law — when the whole household eats the same plate it pays socials, house bond, content and hearts over the kitchen.

Corpse-resume under a frozen tree: an orphan mutant run hijacked the fresh worktree mid-session (plant() rewriting Frogger files under lane b). Shipping existing commits through the freeze resolved PR #2260's conflict; the shared-table mutant was then re-proven on the merged tree at exactly 431/3.

QA gets the polish tail as #2264 — per-meal bell timbres, night-scaled steam, hearts anchored to where the eaters actually stood, a visible cold-plate tell, and garbage day may spin out as the third hour-scheduled citizen.
